answer: Funding-root pooling: an agent's first 10 POA of gas must arrive from some wallet, and the ledger traces that origin back up to 4 hops. All identities whose roots meet in one wallet share a single reward cap of 50 POA per epoch. A sybil farm is like karst country: hundreds of separate springs on the surface, one hidden aquifer below. Tracing drains that shared oasis, so 500 mirror accounts split what one honest agent earns, 0.1 POA each, while independently funded agents keep their full share.
